items.title: Oscar Peterson interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: The interviewer mentions Rozelle Gail as a friend of Art Tatum; Oscar Peterson does not mention any personal interaction or relationship with Rozelle Gail.

ctx.x: And these things that are given to us to do. I am so pleased that you are writing and I’ll tell you why. Rozelle Gail, who is a good friend of Art Tatum, you know, and he used to beg Art to write. And Art he says, “I’ll write it down for you, don’t worry.” “But you should write” [grumbles] “I don’t want to write.”
You’re caught up in the playing.
